lessons.keep: Use one persistent input control to connect several app-specific outputs.
try: For an email assistant, show the exact short request above the pill and highlight the matching sentence in the resulting draft.
Try one restrained perspective panel entrance, then hold it flat for reading and label Draft ready before any send action.
lessons.avoid: Avoid calling a visible draft a completed reply or hiding the instruction needed to judge the result.
lessons.open: Actual voice recognition, personal style matching, compatibility, setup and all heard sound remain unverified.
